title: Lansing BWL Home Rebates 2026: Heat Pump $4,000 to $5,000, Water Heater and More
desc: What Lansing's Board of Water & Light pays in 2026: $4,000 to $5,000 for a heat pump replacing a gas furnace, water heater $500 to $1,000, thermostat $50, insulation and appliances.
h1: Lansing Board of Water & Light Home Rebates
lead: The Lansing Board of Water & Light, called BWL, is Lansing's own electric company. Its 2026 rebates are some of the largest in Michigan for homes that switch from gas to electric, led by $4,000 to $5,000 for a central heat pump. BWL runs the program through Hometown Energy Savers. We read its pages and its 2026 application on October 6, 2026.
cards_intro: Each card names the fact we keep on file. You must be a BWL residential electric customer. Funds are limited, and applications after December 31, 2026 are not accepted.

cards.title: Central heat pump replacing a gas furnace
cards.note: $4,000 when replacing a gas furnace and central air conditioner, $5,000 for the furnace only. Needs a Manual J report, a pre-inspection, and 15.2+ SEER2 and 7.8+ HSPF2 ratings.

cards.title: Heat pump water heater
cards.note: The electrification page says $1,000 and the 2026 application says $500. Confirm with BWL.

cards.title: Heat pump clothes dryer and induction cooktop
cards.note: One rebate per residential account for each item. The dryer must be ENERGY STAR certified and the cooktop needs at least three elements.

cards.title: Smart thermostat
cards.note: For a system with central air or electric heat. One per account.

cards.title: Insulation and air sealing
cards.note: Attic (R-49), wall (R-7) and basement wall (R-20), each with a minimum area. Air sealing needs 30% less leakage.

cards.title: Per-unit heat pump amounts on the 2026 form
cards.note: The form also lists central heat pump amounts by rating and mini-splits at $300, or $500 when replacing electric resistance heat.

cards.title: Federal 25C and 25D tax credits
cards.note: The federal home energy credits ended for work finished after December 31, 2025.

sections: BWL is a municipal utility that sells electricity in Lansing and nearby areas. Its rebates are for its residential electric customers. Your electric bill shows whether BWL is your company. If it is not, look at Consumers Energy or another utility for your area.
Why the heat pump rebate is unusual

The Census Bureau's American Community Survey (2020 to 2024) says utility gas heats 74.6% of Lansing homes and electricity 21.0%. BWL's biggest rebate is aimed at the gas homes, since it applies when a central heat pump replaces a gas furnace. Most utilities pay for heat pumps only when they replace electric heat. BWL's page says you need a Manual J sizing report and a pre-inspection through Hometown Energy Savers at (800) 573-3503.
Two sources, two sets of amounts

BWL's electrification page and its 2026 rebate application both list heat pump and water heater amounts, and they differ. We show both and mark them as needing a check. The safest path is to ask BWL by email which table applies to your job, and keep the answer.

BWL asks you to apply by email, fax or mail within 90 days of buying and no later than December 31, 2026. Receipts must show the equipment type, make, model, price and date. For insulation, the invoice needs the type, the installed R-value and the square feet. BWL says to allow four to six weeks for a check.

If you also buy gas from Consumers Energy, its furnace and insulation rebates are separate. A gas furnace rebate from Consumers does not fit a job that removes the furnace, so plan which program you want before the contractor starts.
claim_steps: Confirm BWL is your electric company.
For a heat pump, call (800) 573-3503 to schedule the pre-inspection first.
Get a quote with a Manual J report and the required ratings.
Save the invoice, model number and AHRI certificate.
Send BWL's 2026 application with receipts by December 31, 2026.
faq: How much does BWL pay for a heat pump?
$4,000 for a central heat pump that replaces a gas furnace and central air conditioner, and $5,000 for a gas furnace only.
